name: Smith's Tools
description:
A portable set of hammers, tongs, punches and a small file supports ordinary forge work.

Tool proficiency is used through the native system check. A furnace, anvil, fuel and raw metal are not included.

weight.notes: Adjusted carried weight for one complete item; 80% of the 2014 baseline.

source.title: Devil's Table: Trade & Merchants
source.reference: SRD 5.1 (2014), Equipment; native field mapping checked against D&D5e release-5.3.3. Original description and adjusted weight. See docs/BLACKSMITH_GUIDE.md.

name: Lock
description:
A small iron padlock is supplied with its matching key. It secures a suitable hasp or chain; those fittings are sold separately.

Under the 2014 equipment rules, a creature proficient with thieves’ tools can pick this ordinary lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity check. The GM resolves the check; purchasing the lock does not configure scene doors.

weight.notes: Adjusted carried weight for the complete iron fitting and key.

source.title: Devil's Table: Trade & Merchants
source.reference: SRD 5.1 (2014) adventuring gear, lock/manacles; original description and adjusted weight.

name: Manacles
description:
A pair of hinged iron restraints is joined by a short chain and supplied with one key. They fit an ordinary Small or Medium creature.

The 2014 baseline uses DC 20 Dexterity to escape or DC 20 Strength to break them. A proficient user of thieves’ tools can pick the lock with a DC 15 Dexterity check. Each set has 15 hit points. The GM handles restraint and damage; no condition is applied automatically.
saleUnit: One set of manacles and matching key

weight.notes: Adjusted carried weight for the complete iron fitting and key.
